# Product strategy

## Does

- Lets café staff mark a POS cart as Eat In or Takeaway from a smart grid tile (default per shop).
- Adds an eat-in charge (default 20% of price, per-product override) to dynamic products (cold food and drink) on Eat In carts; standard- and zero-rated products keep their native Shopify tax settings.
- Records the eat-in charge total, zero-rated total and line breakdown against every order, tags orders Eat In / Takeaway, and shows the breakdown on the admin order page.
- Provides dashboard metrics and filterable reports (date range, order type, channel; daily, variant, customer and order views) with CSV export for VAT returns.

## Does not

- Offer an Eat In / Takeaway choice on the online store; the feature is POS-only.
- Calculate or override Shopify tax lines. The eat-in charge is reported separately and must be treated as output VAT by the merchant's accountant.
- Store order or VAT data in the app database.

## Will never

- Use discounts to emulate removal of VAT.
